name: bim_sync_clash_tests
author: hprebar
title: Sync the HP clash tests for a LOD
description: One Hard clash test per rule of the HP clash matrix (184 pairs, priority P1/P2/P3) eligible at the LOD: LOD200 = 27 tests @ 50 mm, LOD300 = 154 @ 30 mm, LOD350 = 184 @ 10 mm, LOD400 = the LOD350 pairs @ 10 mm (the sheet's column covers 350/400; 10 mm is the BIM lead's choice). Name HP|LOD<lod>|P<n>|<ARC-STR>|<A8-S2> (P = the sheet's priority group Nhóm 1/2/3; sort Clash Detective by name to read it LOD by LOD, group by group — the API cannot create test folders; a test named the earlier HP|P<n>|LOD<lod>|… way is renamed, results kept), selections = the two base search sets (run bim_sync_search_sets with apply=true first). apply=false (default) previews create/update/unchanged/skip per rule; apply=true writes them, upserting by name (an existing test keeps its results, statuses and comments; nothing is removed; tests the matrix no longer lists are reported as orphans) and reads every written test back. A rule whose set is missing or finds nothing is skipped, never widened to the whole model. Does not run tests. One Undo entry; dryRun undoes it.

lod.description: Design stage: 200 basic, 300 technical, 350 construction drawings, 400 fabrication (350 pairs at 10 mm)

apply.description: false = preview only; true = write the tests

priorities.description: Only these priorities (1 = HIGH, 2 = MEDIUM, 3 = LOW); empty = all

ruleIds.description: Only these rules, e.g. ["HP_A8_S2"]; empty = all eligible

listUnchanged.description: Also list the rules whose test is already up to date

notes: Calls HPNavis.BIMCoordinator.CoordinatorTools.SyncClashTests with units.ToMm(1) so tolerances convert from mm to the document units (read back within 0.01 mm). Writes via DocumentClashTests.TestsAddCopy / TestsEditTestFromCopy; selections are SelectionSources of the saved search sets.
